scripts.clean:artifacts: rm -rf packages/circuit/account/target packages/circuit/storage/target packages/circuit/combined/target packages/contracts/src/combined_verifier.sol packages/frontend/public/account_circuit.json packages/frontend/public/storage_circuit.json packages/frontend/public/combined_circuit.json packages/frontend/public/deployment.json packages/contracts/out packages/contracts/cache packages/circuit/combined/out packages/circuit/combined/Prover.toml anvil-logs.txt api-logs.txt
scripts.circuit:combined:prove: cd packages/circuit/combined && export RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 && ${BB_BIN:-bb} prove --slow_low_memory -b ./target/combined.json -w ./target/witness.gz -t evm -k ./target/generated_vk/vk -o ./out -s ultra_honk
scripts.circuit:combined:verifier: cd packages/circuit/combined && ${BB_BIN:-bb} write_solidity_verifier -k ./target/generated_vk/vk -o ../../contracts/src/combined_verifier.sol -s ultra_honk && node ../../contracts/scripts/patch_verifier.js && sed -i 's/assembly {/assembly ("memory-safe") {/g' ../../contracts/src/combined_verifier.sol
scripts.contracts:deploy: cd packages/backend && npx ts-node --esm src/fund_agent.ts && npm run deploy && npm run seed:block
scripts.full:circuit: npm run circuit:combined:compile && npm run circuit:toml && npm run circuit:combined:witness && npm run circuit:combined:vk && npm run circuit:combined:prove
scripts.full:deploy-verifier: npm run circuit:combined:vk && npm run circuit:combined:verifier && npm run contracts:build
scripts.full:test: npm run agent:fund && npm run agent:test
scripts.build:pure: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run circuit:combined:compile && npm run circuit:combined:vk && npm run circuit:combined:verifier && npm run contracts:build
scripts.full:pipeline: npm run build:pure && npm run frontend:sync && npm run contracts:deploy && npm run front
scripts.docker:pipeline: docker compose exec -w /app api npm run build:pure && docker compose exec -w /app api npm run frontend:sync && docker compose exec -w /app api npm run contracts:deploy
scripts.docker:contracts:test: docker compose exec -w /app api npm run contracts:test
scripts.docker:agent:test: docker compose exec -w /app api npm run full:test
scripts.docker:fuzz:solvency: docker compose exec -w /app api npm run fuzz:solvency
